title: Fig Pours Too Much
note: b418 — Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new graphemes ore, oor, our.

pages.brief: Fig the caterpillar on a green leaf, watching a silver watering can tip gently over a row of window box plants.
Fig the caterpillar standing beside a small green watering can on the edge of a window box, looking eager.
Fig the caterpillar tipping a small green watering can right over, a big stream of water pouring onto the window box.
Water pooling over the rim of a window box and dripping down the side, the soil inside dark and soaked.
Green plant shoots in a window box drooping over heavily, weighed down with water.
Fig the caterpillar looking at the drooping green shoots with his antennae lowered.
Fig the caterpillar turning towards Nell the bee, who is hovering beside the window box.
Nell the bee hovering close to a small green watering can, one leg pointing at it.
Fig the caterpillar tipping the small green watering can carefully, a small trickle of water landing on the soil.
Green plant shoots in a window box standing upright again, perky in bright sunshine.
